provenance: v1-v8 are already disclosed AI-synthetic development data. The v2.0.1 patch was motivated by a controlled OCR-flow example where financial commission language was attributed to judged winner selection. This open regression comparison is not a new blind result and does not establish a general accuracy improvement.

patchContext.trigger: Controlled OCR-flow smoke test; not a new detector benchmark.
patchContext.mechanism: Generic word-boundary handling for the lexical judged-selection operator; a substring of commission/percentage wording must not establish judged selection.
patchContext.scope: Known-data regression and paired comparison only; not a measurement of real-world detection, OCR quality, analyst benefit or generalization.

challenge-v1.positiveDefinition: high: observed prize + mandatory entry payment + random selection, without unresolved contradiction
limitations: Synthetic textual scenarios; class prevalence and wording are designed.
Medium cases count as not-high for strict binary metrics; queue metrics use high + medium vs low.
Text metrics exclude OCR, ASR, platform access and human analyst performance.

limitations: All eight corpora, their labels and their challenge frequencies are AI-synthetic hypotheses and are already open.
The patch responds to a context-attribution defect observed in an OCR-flow example; these corpus results do not estimate general accuracy or OCR quality.
Frozen v2.0 and the original first v8 report, corpus, labels, harness and current development-v20 evidence remain separate and are not overwritten.
All current and frozen-baseline predictions, metrics, exact-quote validation errors and paired changes are included; program checks are not a detection-accuracy score.
No real publications, independent human labels, analyst-time savings or new blind test were measured.
